scope: Two rejected Cranelift production-code experiments measured against one frozen React SSR Wasm input. No native image or executable is included.
measurement: Compile-only frozen Wasm native-image preparation; same Wasmtime 47.0.0, generic x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, size-optimized native compilation, backtracking register allocation. Timed value is native_compilation phase; process wall time is separately retained. There was one compile-only process per candidate; percentages are descriptive, not statistical regression claims, and neither candidate establishes application speedup.

toolchain.cargo_profile: release, opt-level 3, line-tables-only debuginfo, overflow checks off
toolchain.source: archived Cargo artifact and timing reports

decision.depth: rejected; +2.84% native compilation time; source removed from product. One compile-only process; descriptive timing, not a statistical regression claim.
decision.hash: rejected; +0.45% native compilation time; source removed from product. One compile-only process; descriptive timing, not a statistical regression claim.
decision.native_text: All three output .text sections are identical: 67,416,064 bytes, SHA-256 34e0ac08afd2a97007f465e63f64ad2de84915e707600b2043b8b028751b10b5.
decision.depth_unit_tests: Not invoked after the negative application probe. Attempts to use workspace-level `cargo test -p` were rejected because the vendor crate is not a workspace member (feature/dev-dependency errors are archived); the isolated depth unit copy was prepared but never tested.
decision.hash_unit_tests: 186 upstream Cranelift unit tests passed; 4 isolated candidate tests passed. These are unit correctness evidence, not an application performance result.
decision.synthetic_hash_probe: For a synthetic 127-key same-initial-bucket cohort only, raw predicates fell 8,128 to 127; one absent-tag lookup 127 to 0. This is not an application or React performance win.

archive.contents: Only UTF-8 source, patches, configuration/identity receipts, build timing HTML, probe result JSON/stdout/stderr, and unit-test logs. No Wasm, ELF/native image, executable, .swpc, cache, or image.
